findings.text: The first independent review of this spec (at a19806e) returned pass_with_notes and named an important finding: the committed git pre-push hooks and copied engine scripts were non-executable (mode 644), so git silently skips the pre-push hook and the documented `git config core.hooksPath hooks` left the local push gate INERT (an unproven push landed). It was systemic across all 5 packs (assemble_pack dropped the exec bit; the authored hooks were committed 644; engine_drift ignored mode). A `bash hook` test masks it because it bypasses the exec-bit requirement; only the git-invoked path exposes it. Everything else in that review passed (faithful byte-identical content copy, drift teeth, reuse, plan reconciliation exact, gate GREEN, caps byte-identical, no pollution).

FIXED comprehensively in this commit (2e76cd0) and re-reviewed: assemble_pack now copies mode (shutil.copy), engine_drift is mode-aware (a content-identical non-executable engine-script copy is reported as 'mode' drift), all committed pack hooks + guard scripts + copied engine scripts are executable, and the selftest asserts every pack's hook + warp-guard.sh is executable and that a stripped exec bit is caught. Retroactively corrects the already-shipped Cursor/Codex/Copilot/Antigravity packs (219 pack files flipped 100644->100755 with byte-identical content). A scoped independent re-review bound to 2e76cd0 returned PASS with 0 blocking and behaviorally proved via the REAL git-invoked path that the local push gate now fires (opencode + cursor: blocks unproven exit 1 / allows proven exit 0; the 644 control lands the push), the mode-drift teeth work, the executable set matches canonical, and the gate is GREEN (selftest 1256/0) with no regression.

Advisory (pre-existing, not a WARP-0807 defect): specs/index.md embeds a 'Generated <date>' line, so a verify run on a later calendar day can go red on the first run (regeneration bumps the date) and green on the second. Also cosmetic: the earlier PLAN-0008 proofs (W2-W6) recorded a shallow front_matter-derived plan_hash; this proof uses the canonical parse_yamlish hash (plan_hash is informational, never re-checked).

summary: W7 of PLAN-0008 (the OpenCode pack) is correct after a review-driven, systemic security fix. The first independent review found a real fail-open: the committed git pre-push hooks and copied engine scripts were non-executable, so git silently skipped the local push gate across all 5 packs. Fixed comprehensively - the assembler preserves mode, the drift-check is mode-aware (catching the class going forward), and every pack's hooks + scripts are committed executable, retroactively correcting the shipped packs. A scoped re-review bound to this commit PASSED (0 blocking) and behaviorally proved via the real git-invoked path that the local push gate now blocks the unproven and allows the proven for opencode and cursor. The pack is a byte-identical committed engine copy + a thin OpenCode driver; reuse is faithful; the bundled PLAN-0008 depends_on reconciliation is exact. Gate GREEN (selftest 1256 passed, 0 failed), no regression, caps byte-identical, no protected path. proof_digest via validate.py.
